$hasVoted.description: Asks Top.gg whether a user voted for the bot in the last 12 hours. Fails with an error when the request fails, so use $try for a fallback

$isVoteWeekend.description: Asks Top.gg whether the weekend multiplier is active (votes count twice). Fails with an error when the request fails, so use $try for a fallback

$monthlyVotes.description: Gets the votes of the bot this month from Top.gg. Fails with an error when the request fails, so use $try for a fallback

$totalVotes.description: Gets the total votes of the bot from Top.gg. Fails with an error when the request fails, so use $try for a fallback

$sendTestVote.description: Sends a test vote to the bot's own running webhook, the way Top.gg does, and returns the HTTP status (204 when it was accepted). The voted event runs with $voteType test; nothing is stored

user ID.description: The voter, defaults to the author

weekend.description: Whether to mark the vote as a weekend vote (legacy webhooks only)

query.description: Query string of the vote page, e.g. ref=abc (legacy webhooks only)

$lastVoteTime.description: Returns when the user last voted (ms timestamp) as recorded by the webhook, empty if no vote was recorded

user ID.description: The user, defaults to the voter in vote events and to the author elsewhere

$nextVoteTime.description: Returns when the user can vote again (ms timestamp) as recorded by the webhook, empty if no vote was recorded

user ID.description: The user, defaults to the voter in vote events and to the author elsewhere

$voteCount.description: Returns how many votes of the user the webhook recorded (test votes excluded)

user ID.description: The user, defaults to the voter in vote events and to the author elsewhere

$votePoints.description: Returns the recorded votes of the user with weekend votes counted twice

user ID.description: The user, defaults to the voter in vote events and to the author elsewhere

$voteStreak.description: Returns how many times in a row the user voted, each vote at most streakGrace (12 hours by default) after they could vote again; 0 once the streak is broken

user ID.description: The user, defaults to the voter in vote events and to the author elsewhere

$votedWithin.description: Returns whether the webhook recorded a vote of the user within the given time, without asking Top.gg

duration.description: How far back to look, e.g. 12h or 1d

user ID.description: The user, defaults to the voter in vote events and to the author elsewhere

$postStatsError.description: Returns the error message, in the error event

$postedServerCount.description: The server count that was posted

$postedShardCount.description: The amount of shards that was posted

$postedShardID.description: The main shard id that was posted

$voteBotID.description: Returns the ID of the bot that was voted for, in the voted event (empty for server votes)

$voteGuildID.description: Returns the ID of the server that was voted for, in the voted event (empty for bot votes)

$voteIsWeekend.description: Returns whether the weekend multiplier was active for the vote (it counts twice)

$voteQuery.description: Returns the query parameters of the vote page URL as JSON, or one parameter's value

key.description: The parameter to return, e.g. ref for ?ref=abc

$voteTimestamp.description: Returns when the vote was cast (ms timestamp)

$voteType.description: Returns the type of the vote, upvote for a real vote or test for the test button

$voteUserID.description: Returns the ID of the user who voted, in the voted event

$voteWeight.description: Returns how many votes the vote counts as, 2 during Top.gg's weekend multiplier, otherwise 1

error.description: This event is fired when posting stats fails, the webhook cannot start, or Top.gg sends a vote that cannot be used

posted.description: This event is fired when your bot's stats were posted to Top.gg

voteReminder.description: This event is fired when a user who voted can vote again (needs the reminders option); the vote functions describe their last vote

voted.description: This event is fired once for each vote (or test vote) Top.gg delivers to your webhook
